question: I moved here with a car. Who do I tell, and what do I have to pay?

nuggets.text: A vehicle owner must apply to the DMV for title and registration before operating it.
nuggets.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this chapter every person who owns a motor vehicle, trailer or semitrailer, or his authorized attorney-in-fact, shall, before it is operated on any highway in the Commonwealth, register with the Department and obtain from the Department the registration card and certificate of title for the vehicle.

nuggets.text: A new resident registers within 30 days.
nuggets.quote: Unless he has previously applied for registration and a certificate of title or he is exempted under §§ 46.2-619 , 46.2-626.1 , 46.2-631 , and 46.2-1206 , every person residing in the Commonwealth who owns a motor vehicle, trailer, or semitrailer, or his duly authorized attorney-in-fact, shall, within 30 days of the purchase or transfer, apply to the Department for a certificate of ownership.

nuggets.text: Registration fees are set by vehicle weight.
nuggets.quote: In no case shall the fee be less than $23 if the vehicle weighs 4,000 pounds or less or $28 if the vehicle weighs more than 4,000 pounds.

nuggets.text: A new resident also reports the vehicle to the city's Commissioner of the Revenue for personal property tax.
nuggets.quote: the city says to contact the Commissioner's Office immediately: call 434-970-3160, email citycor@charlottesville.gov, or go to the Customer Service window in City Hall (605 E Main Street, Room A-130, 8:30 am to 4:30 pm, Monday to Friday).
